description: Four .NET families: static analysis of XAML markup (XamlQuality), the compiled assembly (AssemblyQuality) and the source (CodeQuality), and mutation testing (Testing). Ships as Bennewitz.Ninja.XamlQuality, .XamlQuality.ThemeAudit, .XamlQuality.ThemeRuntime, .AssemblyQuality, .CodeQuality and .Testing.Mutate.

undocumented..claude-plugin: Holds only marketplace.json, the manifest Claude Code reads to serve the drivable-ui plugin in docs/ai-drivable-ui/plugin/. docs/AGENTS.md describes both.

XamlQuality.Trimming: It reads types and IL by reflection (ElementTypes, CompiledStrings), and the trim analyser reports 106 places, measured 2026-10-26. Not trimmable until those warnings are fixed (plans/00009 decision 19 in Bennewitz.Ninja.Templates); its plans/00008 side 2 holds what a repository takes and does not lift this (issue #106).

ConfinedDebug.DebugType: BNAQ1010's fixture compiled as a consumer's Debug build is, unoptimised with its PDB beside the DLL, so the IL reader's sequence points are proved on that shape of symbols as on the embedded one (plans/00011 decision 9). It ships nothing.

XamlQuality.ThemeRuntime.Tests.ImplicitUsings: It compiles the runtime theme check's source files as an adopting project that turns implicit usings off would, so a file that leans on one fails here rather than in that project (plans/00003).
